LanguageData.AAW_ToggleTailleDesc: Allow monkeys to cut nearby stone chunks into blocks at this workshop, hauling distant chunks back when needed.
LanguageData.AAW_ToggleCroquettesDesc: Allow monkeys to make kibble at this workshop from nearby meat and vegetables.
LanguageData.AAW_ToggleBoucherieDesc: Allow monkeys to butcher small wild carcasses near this workshop. A master butcher can field-dress carcasses of any size. Requires a stone knife.
